exempted_policies.reason: SD-LEO-INFRA-CONTINUOUS-EXTERNAL-SURFACE-001 FR-3: a deliberate, permanently-public, exactly-one-row positive canary. The whole point of this policy is that ANY anon-key holder can read it unconditionally -- that is what proves the continuous external-surface checker's own live anon-read path is genuinely alive on a given run rather than silently no-op'ing (a bad key, a dead connection, or a broken query would all fail this read). Not tenant data, not an oversight -- the checker itself (lib/security/continuous-external-surface-checker.mjs) treats a failed canary read as a hard ERROR/VOID verdict specifically because this table must stay unconditionally readable.
